about-p1: Innovega is an IoT company based in Tunisia, focused on building cutting-edge smart agriculture systems.
about-p2: Our first product, Innovega Flow, is a fully wireless, internet-connected irrigation system designed for farms of any size.
about-p3: With potential to expand to industries like home gardening, municipal irrigation, and public utilities, we bring scalable, sustainable solutions to modern resource management.
why-choose-innovega-desc: We offer a wide range of services to help you achieve your goals.
features-subtitle: Designed for real field conditions, Innovega Flow combines long-range wireless connectivity, energy efficiency, reliability, and flexible equipment integration.
feature-solar-energy-desc: Solar-powered controllers with ultra-low energy consumption and 5–7 days of battery autonomy.
feature-lora-wireless-desc: LoRa connectivity with 12 km+ range in suitable conditions, designed to support 1,000+ nodes per gateway.
feature-secure-comm-desc: Proprietary InnoProtocol with device authentication, signed commands, acknowledgements (ACK), and automatic retries.
feature-pump-valve-desc: Integrate compatible pumps, solenoid valves, and water meters into one connected irrigation management system.
feature-no-wires-desc: Wireless field communication eliminates long network cable runs, reducing installation costs, trenching, and cable damage.
services-intro: From remote control to AI-powered optimization, Innovega brings everything you need to manage irrigation efficiently into one connected platform.
remote-irrigation-control-desc: Take full control of your irrigation system from anywhere, anytime.
monitoring-analytics-desc: Get real-time data and detailed reports to optimize water usage.
smart-alerts-desc: Receive instant notifications about leaks, disconnections, and system health.
automation-ai-desc: Enable AI-driven automation for irrigation, fertilization, and resource management.
solar-wireless-hardware-desc: Place irrigation nodes anywhere with no wiring or electrical setup—powered by solar panels and designed for flexibility.
open-close-valves: Open and close irrigation valves remotely
pump-control: Full control over pumps and irrigation systems
schedule-irrigation: Schedule irrigation sessions daily or weekly
